_comment: Engine defaults for lint.mjs (the deterministic half of the lint skill). The engine owns this file: a vault puts its own settings in .scripts/lint.config.org.json, which lint merges over this one (objects merge key by key; an array or value there replaces the one here, so to extend a list, copy it there and add to it). Rhythms map to staleness thresholds below.
_verificationComment: How long a file may go without someone confirming its CONTENT is still true, as distinct from being edited. Deliberately looser than the edit thresholds — an actively-worked file is expected to be touched more often than it is re-read end to end.
_requireVerifiedComment: Move 11c (2026-11-20). Shared context must carry the stamp block (Last Updated, Last verified accurate, Source as of, Owner, Review Cycle). A file here with no Last verified accurate stamp is reported, so 'edited' is never read as 'checked'. registry.yaml is covered by its newest as_of instead.
_refreshContractsComment: Move 11f (2026-11-20). A refresh contract says where a slow file's facts come from, how often that source publishes, and who confirms the file. Each path must also be in operationalFiles (its rhythm sets the confirm window, from verificationThresholdsDays). Lint reads the FIRST date on the file's Source as of line (registry.yaml: newest as_of). It reports 'source-newer' when that date is older than sourceEveryDays + sourceGraceDays, and 'contract-overdue' when Last verified accurate is 'not yet' or older than the confirm window. Lint cannot see the source itself, so 'source-newer' means 'a newer edition is due', not 'one was seen'. Files with no periodic source have no contract and keep the plain staleness check. Contracts name one organisation's sources, so the list is vault-owned (lint.config.org.json); shape: { path, source, sourceEveryDays, confirms }.
_globComment: Pattern-matched operational files. Project STATE.md files were never in the explicit list, so the file the loading model treats as a per-initiative single source of truth was outside the staleness check entirely. Globs mean a new initiative folder is covered the day it is created, without anyone remembering to register it.
_deadPointerDirsComment: Before 2026-08-10 only memory_index.md and SKILL.md files were scanned for dead pointers, so a dangling reference inside a project STATE.md or a context file was structurally unreachable by the check.
_pointerExtensionsComment: Artefact types that count as a checkable reference.
_deadPointerExcludeSourcesComment: Files that cite an EXTERNAL system's file layout as prose/research material, not vault links, so their backtick tokens are not dead pointers. The engine lists only its own such files; a vault adds its own (repo audits, prototypes, history) in lint.config.org.json, copying this list. Add entries here rather than loosening isVaultPathToken further: the token shapes are indistinguishable from real vault paths, only the source's purpose tells them apart.
_deployedSkillMirrorsComment: The vault is the source of truth for deployed skills; this check diffs the copies that actually execute. mode=copy: the deployed file must be byte-identical to the vault source (Claude Code reads real files off disk, e.g. ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md). mode=pointer: the deployed file is a thin loader that must NOT contain the skill body, only name the vault path (claude.ai uploaded packages, which cannot be diffed). An unreadable mirror reports amber, not silence; an empty list reports its own absence. Which skills a vault deploys, and where, is vault-owned: list them in lint.config.org.json. Entry shape: { name, mode, vault, deployed }.
_privateBoundaryComment: Two vaults (added 2026-11-13). This folder is the shared vault. The private vault is a separate folder outside the repo, mounted here as a gitignored symlink. Check 9: must-fix if the mount is not gitignored; should-fix (leakSeverity) if a shared content file names a specific private file. Set leakSeverity to red before a vault is shared. Naming a private folder by convention is allowed. Engine files (index, AGENTS, skills) are exempt until the team version generalises them.
_stateBudgetsComment: Field budgets for STATE files (check 8, added 2026-10-29). Mirrors diff-propose/SKILL.md 'STATE is a snapshot, not a history'; change both together. strictFiles are diff-propose pilots (vault-owned: set them in lint.config.org.json) and report must-fix; other glob matches report should-fix because they use the pre-budget schema. Word counts exclude the bullet marker.
_runIntegrityComment: Checks that the pipeline actually RAN, not just that its output was well-formed: a stale deployed copy can produce a plausible chat answer and write no file at all. Absence is the signal. graceWeekdays=1 means: by the end of the next weekday, a valid output for the previous weekday must exist somewhere in searchDirs. expectedVersion is read live from the source SKILL.md frontmatter, so bumping the skill version invalidates output from an older copy. Which jobs a vault runs is vault-owned: list them in lint.config.org.json. Entry shape: { name, sourceSkill, artifactPattern, searchDirs, weekdaysOnly, graceWeekdays, footerRe }.
_factsComment: PLAN S2.4 (2026-11-22). Typed facts: one file per fact in <Initiative>/facts/, template 3_RESOURCES/framework/templates/FACT.template.md. Check 11: must-fix if a required field is missing, the type is unknown, the status is not valid for the type, or a date is malformed. Should-fix if a live fact (status in `live`) has verified 'not yet' or older than freshnessDays for its type. Closed facts (superseded, retired, answered, dropped) are history and are not aged.

facts._verifiedPointerComment: Decided 2026-11-22: verified means a person checked, or a source can be pointed to directly (metric, Slack message, Google Doc) that states the fact or confirms it correct. A dated `verified` needs `source` to match this: a URL, a Jira/Productboard key (ABC-123), `metric:<registry id>`, or `Checked by <Name>`. Definition text: FACT.template.md.

_largeFilesComment: Audit item 12. Amber for .md files over maxKB in dirs. allow = kept sources an agent reads by section (AGENTS.md rule), not working files.
_notFilledComment: F1.3 (2026-11-22). Check 13 not-filled: what a new vault still has to fill in, reported in its own section (JSON findings.todo), never as must-fix or should-fix. A file with the marker line (a whole line `> Not filled in yet.`, or a `#` comment ending in it) skips the staleness checks and is listed here instead. patterns are template text, checked in operational files only. profiles: Key | Value tables whose blank, (set X) or {{X}} values are listed by key. cycleFile: listed when it names no cycle and no dates.

patterns: Empty\. Fills as material is ingested\.
